name: Spellreign
summary:
**Magic was never meant to be a button.**

In Spellreign, every spell is cast by gesture: trace its sigil in the air and unleash it. Master sixteen spells across four elements - fire, water, air and earth - and prove yourself against monsters and real players alike.

**Features**
- Gesture casting: trace the sigil, unleash the spell. Precision and speed are your weapons.
- 1v1 online duels: no cooldowns, no decks. Every spell you have learned is yours to use, every round.
